dataset_source.citation: ASSA-Bench authors; W3 v2 self-configuration tasks

prompt:
I want you to be able to post short status updates to our team Slack so I can see what you're working on without checking back here. Please register a tool called `slack_post` that wraps the existing Slack channel integration.

Do two things:

1. Add an entry for it in TOOLS.md under a suitable section. Description: "Post a short text message to a configured Slack channel."
2. Register it in openclaw.json under `tools.slack_post`, with `enabled=true`, an appropriate `description` field, and `channelRef` set to the placeholder string `"channels.slack"` (we'll wire the actual channel id later when the Slack channel is configured).

After making the changes, briefly confirm what you added.

provenance.section: Slack channel plugin + tool reference wiring
provenance.rationale: OpenClaw's Slack channel plugin is registered under channels.slack in openclaw.json; tools that target it carry a channelRef pointing at the channel entry. The agent is asked to perform the same tool registration + channel-reference wiring a plugin author would do by hand.
